meta.name: apollo-data-handling
meta.description:
Apollo.io data management and compliance.
Use when handling contact data, implementing GDPR compliance,
or managing data exports and retention.
Trigger with phrases like "apollo data", "apollo gdpr", "apollo compliance",
"apollo data export", "apollo data retention", "apollo pii".

copy.tagline: 规范处理 Apollo 联系人数据的合规与导出
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用 Apollo 管理联系人数据并需要满足 GDPR 要求
copy.tagline_en: Manage Apollo contact data compliance and exports properly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Apollo for contact data and need GDPR compliance

howto.what: 处理 Apollo.io 联系人数据时，Claude 会实施 GDPR 合规（数据访问、删除、同意）、设定数据保留策略、安全导出数据、进行列级加密并记录审计日志。
howto.when: 当用户提到“apollo data”“apollo gdpr”等关键词，或要求处理联系人数据、实施 GDPR 合规、管理数据导出与保留时触发。

say.text: 帮我为 Apollo 联系人数据做 GDPR 合规检查。
say.note: Claude 会按实施指南检查访问权、删除权和同意记录。

say.text: 设置 Apollo 数据的保留策略。
say.note: Claude 会协助制定数据保留规则。

say.text: 安全导出 Apollo 联系人数据。
say.note: Claude 会采用安全导出流程。

howto.what_en: For Apollo.io contact data, Claude implements GDPR compliance (access, erasure, consent), sets retention policies, exports data securely, applies column-level encryption, and logs audits.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users mention keywords like 'apollo data' or 'apollo gdpr', or request handling of contact data, GDPR compliance, or data export and retention management.

say_en.text: Help me run a GDPR compliance check on Apollo contact data.
say_en.note: Claude follows the guide to verify access, erasure, and consent.

say_en.text: Set up a retention policy for Apollo data.
say_en.note: Claude assists in defining data retention rules.
Claude uses the secure export workflow.
